messages:
sylvia.g: Creating RC for embed-service -> 2.4.1-rc.1. Pushing for sign-off and promo to prod during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Release notes: https://go/release/embeds/2.4.1-rc.1
sylvia.g: Changelist: tokenizer edge-case fix, KV cache warm improvements, routing guard for model fallback.
sylvia.g: @deploybot please pin artifact sha256:abc123def and start canary at 5% when ready
deploybot: queued: pin embed-service@2.4.1-rc.1 -> sha256:abc123def. Prechecks: build ok, infra quotas ok, db-migrations: none. Reply `confirm` to proceed.
qa_ron: confirm. smoke tests passed on staging: PASS 42/42
qa_ron: reran the flaky embed-alloc test after fix, logs:
```
[2026-03-21 01:12:34] embed-smoke OK
[2026-03-21 01:12:59] latency p50 45ms p95 110ms
```
sre_jay: kv warm note: recommend a 10m warm before shifting heavier traffic. I'll monitor /v1/embed and tail errors.
mo: suggest canary plan: 5% for 30m, then 25% for 20m, then 100% if stable. Abort if p95 > 300ms or error rate > 0.5%.
lina: +1 from product, release notes and customer-facing blurb look good. oncall notified.
sylvia.g: Approvals: qa_ron, sre_jay, mo, lina all +1. @deploybot confirm to begin rollout.
deploybot: starting rollout: canary 5% -> routes configured. Pin applied: embed-service@2.4.1-rc.1 (sha256:abc123def). Deployment id: dep-6210000000-01
sre_jay: observing canary: p95 120ms, errors 0. No spikes. KV caches warming.
mo: canary stable after 25m. Recommend promote to 25% now.
sylvia.g: Promote to 25%.
deploybot: increased traffic to 25%. Checkpoint timer set for 20m. Telemetry tags: rollout=2.4.1-rc.1
sre_jay: 25% looks healthy. p95 130ms, error rate 0.03%. KV warm steady.
mo: proceeding to full if next 20m stays green.
sylvia.g: final go for full promote after checkpoint. @deploybot proceed when ready.
deploybot: Promotion to prod complete. Final pin: embed-service@2.4.1-rc.1. Rollout summary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with gradations and no aborts. If rollback needed run:
```
# rollback to previous stable version
/rollout set-traffic embed-service --version=2.4.0 --weight=100
/deploybot unpin embed-service@2.4.1-rc.1
```
lina: Release note on the portal updated: https://go/release/embeds/2.4.1. Customer comms draft in tracker.
qa_ron: quick post-checks: traces and logs show no regressions for last 30m. smoke checks green.
mo: :thumbsup:
sylvia.g: Thanks team — closing this thread. Any follow-ups, add to EMBED-421 in tracker.
